candidate.user_submission: This child is 18 months old. The child has fever for 2 days. The temperature is 38.0°C. The child has fever but there is no obvious cause of fever seen. The area is high malaria risk. Malaria test is available and the result is negative. There is clouding of the cornea, and the child has generalized rash. The eyes are red but there is no pus draining from the eye. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child is not convulsing now and has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child does not vomit everything. The child has not had measles within the last 3 months, and there is no cough with measles. The child does not have mouth ulcers. There is no stiff neck. The child does not have runny nose. No bacterial cause of fever has been identified in this assessment. The child does not have cough or difficult breathing, diarrhoea, or ear problem.
